reviewType: independent AI translation review in a separate agent session

scope.coverage: Full titles, descriptions, article bodies, tables, prompts, code/output, image alt text and all localized SVG title/desc/text; compared to the published Korean articles and Korean SVGs. English source used by the structural comparator. Writer verdicts were not read.

checks: Full meaning, omissions/additions, negation, conditions, security and privacy limits.
Korea-specific Pickle free-use and daily-limit facts remain explicitly regional.
Aside summary prompt still requires one Korean sentence; synthetic CSV input is distinguished from real Aside output.
Actual shell/Python code and recorded output blocks compared directly with Korean sources and are identical.
Article prose retains original limits on product execution, measurements, Windows support and server/process restoration.
Localized SVG labels and descriptions preserve the source flow and limits.

findings.before: Pickle peut demander les informations nécessaires puis afficher une carte
findings.reason: The Korean source describes asking needed information, while possibility applies to displaying a confirmation card. French had extended the possibility qualifier to both.
findings.fix: Pickle demande les informations nécessaires et peut ensuite afficher une carte
findings.recheck: Corrected text preserves both the information request and the optional card.

findings.before: organiser les résultats de recherche en fichier
findings.fix: organiser les résultats de recherche dans un fichier
findings.recheck: Title now uses natural French without changing its meaning.

fixes: Changed only the two French manuscript phrases listed above. No German or SVG content changes were needed.

validation.result: All 30 emitted manuscript/SVG pairs passed, including all 10 DE/FR pairs.
validation.additional: Direct Python equality check of actual shell/Python blocks and recorded output against Korean sources passed for all ten DE/FR articles. Pseudocode and authored prompts are intentionally localized.

limits: AI source-to-translation review; no human or native-speaker validation.
No external product fact revalidation or website browsing.
No new execution of the published shell, Python, Aside, Pickle or workflow examples; the report only checks preservation of the source’s recorded execution claims.
SVG XML text and structure reviewed; no rendered-layout or browser visual inspection.
